name: Open-Meteo
summary: Read weather, archive and CAMS air-quality forecasts from the Open-Meteo APIs; commercial use goes through the customer host with an API key.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Sent as the apikey query parameter on the customer host. Store it with ogun secrets set.

egress.note: The key is for the customer host only; the others are the keyless hosts.

notes: Used by examples/bikeshare/ridership-forecast.workflow.json through the builtin acquire@1. Terms: commercial use needs a key, passed as a secret query parameter, weather data needs the attribution "Weather data by Open-Meteo.com", and CAMS data needs "Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service via Open-Meteo". Check the licence again before you rely on it.
